title: Accept the cookie consent banner
description: This verifies a first-time visitor can acknowledge the cookie banner and continue browsing without it remaining visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Verify the cookie consent banner is visible
Accept all cookies
Verify the cookie consent banner is no longer visible

title: Accept cookies and explore the homepage sections
description: This test verifies that a first-time visitor can accept the cookie banner and navigate through the main homepage sections from the primary navigation.
category: Homepage discovery and persistent UI controls

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click to accept the cookie banner
Click the navigation link to view the solutions section
Click the navigation link to view the services section
Click the navigation link to view the industries section
Click the navigation link to view the about us section
Click the navigation link to view the partners section
Verify the solutions, services, industries, about us, and partners sections are displayed

title: Switch the site between supported languages
description: This verifies a visitor can switch the homepage content between Spanish, English, and French and return to Spanish successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click the English language switch
Verify the site content is displayed in English
Click the French language switch
Verify the site content is displayed in French
Click the Spanish language switch
Verify the site content is displayed in Spanish

title: Switch the site language across the homepage
description: This test verifies that a visitor can switch between the supported homepage languages and see the site content update accordingly.
category: Homepage discovery and persistent UI controls

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click to accept the cookie banner
Switch the site language to English
Switch the site language to French
Switch the site language back to Spanish
Verify the homepage content updates for the selected languages and returns to Spanish

title: Submit the contact inquiry form successfully
description: This test verifies that a visitor can complete the contact form, pass the on-page security verification, and receive a success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /#contacto
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the corporate email field with a valid corporate email address
Complete the cloud security verification
Submit the form
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Toggle the site theme on the homepage
description: This verifies a visitor can switch between dark and light appearance modes from the homepage.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Toggle the theme setting
Verify the page is displayed in dark mode
Toggle the theme setting again
Verify the page is displayed in light mode

title: Toggle theme across the homepage
description: This test verifies that a visitor can switch between light and dark theme modes and that the homepage remains visually consistent.
category: Homepage discovery and persistent UI controls

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click to accept the cookie banner
Toggle the site theme to dark mode
Scroll to the solutions section
Scroll to the services section
Scroll to the footer area
Toggle the site theme back to light mode
Verify the site content remains visible and consistent in both theme modes

title: Handle the cookie banner once and keep browsing the homepage
description: This verifies the consent banner can be dismissed and the visitor can still use the homepage navigation afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Accept all cookies
Click the link to the solutions section
Click the link to the services section
Verify the cookie consent banner is no longer visible
Verify the homepage navigation sections are displayed

title: Switch the site language and browse key sections
description: This verifies a multilingual visitor can change the homepage language and still navigate to the main informational sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click the English language switch
Click the link to the solutions section
Click the link to the services section
Click the link to the industries section
Click the link to the about us section
Click the link to the partners section
Verify the key informational sections are displayed
Verify the site remains in English

title: Browse solutions cards from the homepage
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open the solutions section and review the available solution cards.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click to accept the cookie banner
Click the navigation link to view the solutions section
Verify solution cards are displayed

title: Keep theme styling consistent while browsing major sections
description: This verifies the selected theme remains visually consistent when moving across the main homepage sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Toggle the theme setting
Click the link to the solutions section
Click the link to the services section
Click the link to the industries section
Click the link to the partners section
Verify the dark theme styling is applied across the site sections
Verify the site sections remain readable and consistent

title: Expand service details in the services section
description: This test verifies that a visitor can access the services section and reveal detailed service information through the accordion controls.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click to accept the cookie banner
Click the navigation link to view the services section
Expand a service accordion section
Expand another service accordion section
Verify service details are displayed

title: Open the mock portal login page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can reach the mock customer portal login entry point from the site navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click to accept the cookie banner
Click the navigation link to open the login page
Verify the login form is displayed

title: Review industry experience cards
description: This test verifies that a visitor can view the industries section and inspect the company’s sector experience cards.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click to accept the cookie banner
Click the navigation link to view the industries section
Verify industry experience cards are displayed

title: Submit the mock portal login form
description: This test verifies that a visitor can enter corporate credentials and submit the mock portal login form without the page breaking.

steps.description: Navigate to /#login
Fill in the corporate email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the page remains in a usable state after submission

title: Review company history and values
description: This test verifies that a visitor can navigate to the about us section and see the company timeline and core values content.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click to accept the cookie banner
Click the navigation link to view the about us section
Verify the company timeline and core values are displayed

title: Review partner logos and channel strip
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open the partners section and view the trusted partner and integrator branding.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click to accept the cookie banner
Click the navigation link to view the partners section
Verify partner logos and the channel integrator strip are displayed

title: Handle repeated homepage controls without breaking the page
description: This verifies rapid repeated use of the language and theme controls leaves the homepage usable and consistent.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click the English language switch
Click the French language switch
Click the Spanish language switch
Toggle the theme setting
Toggle the theme setting again
Verify the homepage content is displayed normally
Verify the homepage theme is displayed normally

title: Reach the mock registration entry point
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open the mock account registration page from the site navigation and view its entry state.

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click to accept the cookie banner
Click the navigation link to open the registration page
Verify the registration entry point is displayed

title: Show validation when contact form is incomplete
description: This test verifies that the contact form prevents submission when required information is missing and shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /#contacto
Submit the form without entering required details
Verify validation feedback is visible

title: Show validation when contact verification is not completed
description: This test verifies that the contact form requires the on-page security verification before submission is accepted.

steps.description: Navigate to /#contacto
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the corporate email field with a valid corporate email address
Submit the form without completing the cloud security verification
Verify a validation error is visible

title: Handle repeated language and theme controls
description: This test verifies that rapidly changing language and theme controls does not break the homepage navigation or section visibility.
category: Homepage discovery and persistent UI controls

steps.description: Navigate to /#inicio
Click to accept the cookie banner
Switch the site language to English
Switch the site language to Spanish
Toggle the site theme to dark mode
Toggle the site theme back to light mode
Click the navigation link to view the contact section
Verify the contact section is displayed and the homepage controls remain usable
